steps.title: Configure App Metadata

steps.title: Define Schema Configuration
steps.description: Configure api_schema.json and admin_setting_schema.json for offline OCR processing.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build System
steps.description: Include Google ML Kit Text Recognition dependency and compile options in build.gradle.

steps.title: Setup Android Manifest & Permissions
steps.description: Declare camera permissions and FileProvider in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Configure UI Resources & Themes
steps.description: Define application colors, strings, and style definitions.

steps.title: Create Scan Data Model
steps.description: Implement ScanModel Java class for OCR record items.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Storage Helper
steps.description: Create ScanHistoryDbHelper for local persistence of scanned text and timestamps.

steps.title: Build History List Adapter
steps.description: Construct HistoryAdapter to render scan records with copy, share, and delete actions.

steps.title: Design Main Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout with camera scan, gallery upload, and scan metrics.

steps.title: Design OCR Result Screen Layout
steps.description: Create activity_result.xml layout for text editing, copying, and sharing actions.

steps.title: Design Scan History Layout
steps.description: Create activity_history.xml and item_history.xml for browsing and filtering past scans.

steps.title: Implement OCR Engine & Main Activity
steps.description: Code camera capture, image picker, and Google ML Kit Text Recognition in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Result Activity Logic
steps.description: Code text viewing, inline editing, copying to clipboard, and text sharing in ResultActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement History Activity Logic
steps.description: Code history search, clear-all confirmation, and item deletion in HistoryActivity.java.

steps.title: Building Smart OCR Scanner
steps.description: Compile final APK package and verify offline OCR execution.
